canonical_statement: For every snake input in an arbitrary abelian category, the six-term sequence from the three kernel objects through the connecting morphism to the three cokernel objects is exact.
domain_and_universes: C : Type u with Category.{v} C and Abelian C; S : ShortComplex.SnakeInput C
hypotheses: The four-row diagram, kernel/cokernel witnesses, middle-row exactness, Epi S.L1.g, and Mono S.L2.f packaged by S
conclusion: S.composableArrows.Exact for the six objects S.L0.X1, S.L0.X2, S.L0.X3, S.L3.X1, S.L3.X2, S.L3.X3 and the connecting morphism S.delta.
minimal_import_evidence: This is the defining module for ShortComplex.SnakeInput, its connecting morphism, composableArrows, and the exactness type used by the target. The legacy HomologySequenceLemmas and Algebra.Module.SnakeLemma imports are not needed.

killed: removed the snake input and all of its packaged diagram hypotheses
moved the snake-input binder into a Nonempty conclusion
added short-exact endpoint assumptions that extend the sequence beyond the canonical six terms

boundary_cases.zero_objects_and_zero_maps: No nonzero-object or nonzero-map premise is introduced; such cases remain covered by SnakeInput.
boundary_cases.endpoint_extension: Mono S.L1.f and Epi S.L2.g are not required, so exactness at the canonical six terms does not silently become the stronger zero-extended sequence.
boundary_cases.sequence_extent: The root is exactly the six-term kernel/cokernel sequence, not an arbitrary derived-functor long exact sequence or the separate homology-sequence target.

status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates only the exact six-term Lean target. It does not inspect or credit ShortComplex.SnakeInput.snake_lemma, and supplies no anchor-audit, proof, validation, release, audit-completion, or theorem-completion evidence.
